visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-bleed 16:9 home stage carousel with indicator dots and prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Home stage carousel: full-bleed slides (16:9 image from 768px, 3:4 image below), headline and link text over the image, the whole slide is the link; indicator dots labelled by hidden text, previous/next arrows from 1200px; autoplays every 5 s with 1 s fades (off with prefers-reduced-motion). Slides without images render as video stage frames. Marks its section so the transparent header morphs over it
